predeclared_plan.previous_goal_turn_classification: PROGRESS: 18 reviewed local calls and exact precision candidate preparation; neither produced a promoted answer generator.
predeclared_plan.changed_dimension: RRF constant only within the already measured title-weight-zero hybrid, using exactly its saved lexical/vector branch rankings. Compare against unchanged selected vector output.
predeclared_plan.course_source: cohorts/2026/04-evaluation/homework.md, Q6 and Using this framework (lines 262–296)
predeclared_plan.hypothesis: Smaller k weights a high single-branch rank more strongly and may retain strong vector-only references previously displaced by agreement on weaker candidates. This is a diagnostic hypothesis, not a guaranteed gain.
predeclared_plan.controls: Same 42 development questions, frozen references, source/corpus, branch candidate sets/order, lexical field weights, top-5 and zero-based rank convention. No fresh retrieval, encoder or model calls. k=50 must reconstruct the stored baseline exactly.
predeclared_plan.acceptance: First reproduce all saved k=50 ranked IDs and reference metrics. Nomination requires greater mean reference coverage than vector with no per-question coverage decrease on the 35 answerable questions. Missing/absent-evidence cases remain in the file, excluded only from the already defined retrieval denominator. If no candidate qualifies, retain vector. Even a qualified replay requires a fresh runtime retrieval check and downstream answer evidence before promotion.
tradeoffs: Small k can overvalue an erroneous top lexical hit
Large k can favor branch agreement over a strong vector-only source
A fixed top-5 budget can force loss of an already useful source; increased cutoff would be a separate experiment
Frozen reference matching is not exhaustive semantic relevance and no official passing threshold is inferred
alternatives_rejected: Activate hybrid for an optional point despite known retrieval losses
Change labels to make alternate snippets count without review
Combine a new cutoff/weight with this constant-only experiment
Use final questions for parameter selection
predeclared_plan.heldout_exposure: No final inference or selection; bank previously readable/validated, not claimed unseen.
predeclared_plan.next_action: Recompute the declared four rankings, verify baseline reconstruction and inspect gains/losses by question and all six slices. No active configuration mutation.

limitations: Saved-rank replay on tuning questions with provisional reference labels. No fresh retrieval, generated-answer, abstention, latency or end-to-end validation. Final-set questions are excluded from computation, not claimed unseen.
